why: ⚠ TWO GENERAL AUDITS RATHER THAN TWO MORE STAGE TESTS. Is a TREE whole — its canopy within vanilla's decay distance of a log, and symmetric about its own trunk — and is the world UNAWARE OF ITS OWN CHUNK GRID?
